summary: EQT Private Equity Company LLC filed an 8-K reporting the sale of unregistered shares to third-party investors for cash aggregate consideration of ~$29.45M at per-share prices based on transactional net asset value (NAV) as of June 30, 2026. The sales were exempt under Sections 4(a)(2), Regulation D, and/or Regulation S. The filing also discloses the Transactional NAV per share for multiple classes. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation; continuous offering of shares is ordinary business for an investment company. No special-situation event is present.
